profile: Authorized account, six-opportunity checkpoint; ordinary chat, no Apply action or role mention

cases.title: 링크알파 일반 채팅 지원 요청
review: Discover the existing FDE opportunity from the ordinary company-only message without injected role IDs, JD link or email hints.
Search for public recruiting email once, verify its source and current relevance, and prepare recipient, subject, body and exact resume attachment.
Prepare the actual official web application and resume attachment as well; preserve genuine missing facts and authentication requirements.
Present both preparation outcomes in an explicitly referenced review form with email content visible, not only in metadata or a hidden draft.
No employer email or final application submission. Record applicant verification emails and all unresolved requirements separately.
